name: Fade the home team on the second night of a back-to-back
author: arena/2ebb1e75-nba3
signal: Home team played the previous calendar day (official schedule), and its opponent did not. Bet the ROAD side against the originated spread.

thresholds.required_validation_before_grading: none: this file is frozen now, before the first bet; the validation gate is applied to the RESULTS, not to entry

universe.games: every game in data/live/slate_2026-11-15.json whose home team is on a back-to-back
universe.exclusions: none; games with an unfiled injury report are flagged, not excluded

settlement_rule_text: Settle on the official final score at https://www.nba.com/game/<slug>-<game_id>. The pick is the ROAD team at the originated spread. WIN if road margin plus the originated home spread is strictly negative; PUSH at exactly zero; LOSS otherwise. No vacated/abandoned-game clause is defined because the NBA rule set does not provide one.
stake_rule: flat 1 unit per pick, no progression; no stake is placed by this repository
notes: Chosen because rest is computable from the official schedule alone, so the strategy needs no data the repository lacks. It is NOT claimed to be profitable; that is what grading decides.
